reason: Why pay nearly ₹13,000 a year for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free and handle our small two-person practice? Even though the July ITR and October ROC filing rush causes deadline panic with my article clerk, in a normal week I cannot justify an annual subscription when our current routine costs zero.
objection: Why pay for software when Excel and WhatsApp are completely free, and will my article clerk actually stick to these checklists without me having to micro-manage them?
would_change_my_mind: If testing the free 2-seat pilot during a filing rush proves that the maker-checker audit trail eliminates my panic over article clerk mistakes before ICAI/ICSI peer reviews.
